Idm Profile Resource Get Summary
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/idmprofile/lite

-> Gets a list of active IDM templates (or IDM profiles) and their criteria, only.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
activeOnly
boolean

If set to true, only active IDM templates (or profiles) are returned in the response.

Default value: true
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
profileId
int32

The unique identifier for the IDM template (i.e., IDM profile).

templateName
string

The IDM template name.

clientVm
object
numDocuments
int32

The number of documents.

lastModified
int32

The timestamp the IDM template was last modified.

modifiedBy
object
]
